title: Reynolds number of a settling grit particle
applicability: Reynolds number used to choose the settling-velocity equation; Stoke's law holds good for R below 1.0.
notes: Unnumbered display expression: p344-1 is a service locator, not a printed equation number.
R itself is not defined in the printed symbol list on this page.
